summary: Verified iteration 12: new /api/campaigns filter/sort/search params + budget_bounds on filters endpoint, plus polished /campaigns UI, landing motion, and editorial mastheads on /signup and /login. 17/17 new backend pytest cases pass (test_campaign_filters.py). 13/13 OTP auth regression tests still pass (test_otp_auth.py). All requested frontend flows work end-to-end. Found ONE minor UX inconsistency: changing only the sort dropdown does not surface the 'Clear all' button because hasFilters logic excludes sort state.

ui_bugs.issue: Changing ONLY the sort dropdown (e.g. selecting 'Budget: high to low') does NOT show the clear-filters-btn. hasFilters at line 214 checks area/category/budget/debouncedQ but not sort. If the intended UX is that any non-default filter/sort should surface Clear all, add `|| sort !== 'newest'` to hasFilters and reset sort in resetAll (which is already there). If sort is intentionally excluded, ignore. Search+budget+area+category all correctly surface the Clear all button, and resetAll does reset sort back to 'newest'.

action_items: OPTIONAL: extend hasFilters in /app/frontend/src/pages/Campaigns.jsx line 214 to include `|| sort !== 'newest'` so the Clear all button also appears when the user has only re-sorted the list.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~2444 lines — the new list_campaigns() adds nice params but the file continues to grow; suggest extracting campaign routes into /app/backend/routers/campaigns.py.

list_campaigns q param builds a $or with regex on title/brief/deliverables — for larger seed sets consider a MongoDB text index (`db.campaigns.create_index([('title','text'),('brief','text'),('deliverables','text')])`) and use `$text`; current re.escape guards against ReDoS which is good.

campaign_filters budget_bounds pipeline: returns {min:None,max:None} shape when no numeric budgets exist — the UI currently trusts these are numbers (BUDGET_BUCKETS are hardcoded anyway), so safe today, but consider omitting min/max keys when null to make the contract explicit.
Campaigns.jsx line 214 hasFilters excludes sort — see UI bug above.
Campaigns.jsx debouncedQ debounce interval — verify it matches backend expectation (worked at ~600-900ms in tests). Consider setting explicit 300ms.

rca of the issue: Minor UI inconsistency: Clear all button hidden after sort-only change. Root cause: `hasFilters` in Campaigns.jsx (line 214) does not include `sort !== 'newest'` in its OR chain. Fix: add that clause. resetAll already resets sort to 'newest' so the fix is a 1-line change.
